instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Bloomberg-Terminal-grade cricket analytics engine in React (JS) + FastAPI backend. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testids, read-only analytics disclaimer is prominent, and all fixture, odds, same-game multis, multi-fixture portfolios, historic performance, and model insight views are fully interactive.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
